video.preprocessing: uniform endpoint-inclusive frames within each causal window; resize-short-side, center crop 288, RGB float32 [0,1]; mean all output tokens to 768D

audio.preprocessing: decode mono 48kHz AAC by PyAV; resample to 16kHz; Whisper 30s log-mel; mean valid encoder tokens to 384D

text.preprocessing: frozen masked-mean embedding of each window's exact task question to 384D

best_checkpoint_selector: lowest validation NLL; ties keep earliest step
training_sampling: uniform shuffle of training sessions; each session used once per epoch
loss: unweighted cross entropy over labelled windows; natural prevalence retained
unlabelled_windows: retained as causal LSTM context; excluded from loss and metrics
validation: fixed official validation sessions; evaluate all labelled windows; no test split
scope: development-only HoloAssist session-disjoint correct-action task; not a broad Omni quality claim
